strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute opening candle, mark the first 9:30-9:35 candle high/low, then use the 1-minute chart to wait for price to break the level, form a fair value gap, retest back into that FVG, and get the retest candle engulfed before entering long (after a bullish break above the high).
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop under the lowest area traded into the FVG with one tick of breathing room, and take a fixed 3:1 profit target. After entry, do not micromanage the trade.

variants.timeframe_note: Start on 5-minute chart, confirm on 1-minute chart
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for FVG retest and engulfing candle before entry
variants.transcript_quote: we're going to wait for a retest of the fair value gap... then we wait for this retest candle right here to get engulfed... you're good to enter the 3

strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_limit_order_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute opening candle, mark the first 9:30-9:45 candle high/low, then switch to the 5-minute chart, wait for price to create a fair value gap after breaking the level, and enter automatically with a passive limit order placed on the FVG as price trades back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at the first candle in the FVG pattern, just under that candle, and target a fixed 2:1 return. After entry, let the market do the heavy lifting without micromanaging, even if price revisits the FVG later.

variants.variant_label: 15-minute opening range with 5-minute limit entry, 2:1 target
variants.timeframe_note: Start on 15-minute chart, confirm on 5-minute chart
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: set a limit order on the FVG instead of waiting for a retest/engulfing candle
variants.transcript_quote: instead of waiting for a retest, we're actually going to set a limit order on the FVG... we are going to target a fixed 2:1 return
